metadata.title: The Alexander polynomial of twisted torus knots in the complementary range
metadata.abstract: A twisted torus knot T(p,q;r,s) is obtained from the flat-torus diagram of T(p,q) by inserting s full twists along a disk meeting r adjacent strands. Our previous work determined its Alexander polynomial for 1<r<=max{|p|,|q|}. In this paper, we compute it in the complementary range max{|p|,|q|}<r<=|p|+|q| by placing the knot on a standard genus-two Heegaard surface and applying Fox calculus. We then combine the two calculations into a unified Alexander-polynomial formula valid for 1<r<=|p|+|q|. In the complementary range, we prove monicity and give an explicit formula for the breadth. This determines the Seifert genus for nonnegative twists and gives a genus lower bound for negative twists. We also exhibit infinite two-parameter families of non-L-space knots in the complementary range.
metadata.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Comments and suggestions are welcome

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 扭转环面结多项式的补充范围计算
analysis.workSummary: 对 T(p,q;r,s)，在 max{|p|,|q|}<r≤|p|+|q| 范围，经亏格二 Heegaard 曲面和 Fox 微分计算 Alexander 多项式，并合成覆盖 1<r≤|p|+|q| 的统一公式。在补充范围证明首一性、计算宽度，确定非负扭转的 Seifert 亏格，对负扭转仅得亏格下界，另构造无穷双参数非 L-space 结族。
analysis.breakthrough: 补齐既有公式的参数范围，并得到一侧精确、另一侧仅下界的亏格信息。
analysis.limitations: 精确亏格只针对非负扭转；负扭转不可写为精确公式，非 L-space 族也不代表补充范围所有结。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
